Site.description: The Site JSON Schema is designed to capture essential details for creating and managing SharePoint sites.

DisplayName.description: The display name of the site, e.g., 'Marketing Team Site'.

Description.description: An optional description of the site.

MailNickname.description: The mail nickname for the site, must be lowercase alphanumeric, e.g., 'marketingteam'.

Visibility.description: The visibility setting for the site.

Owners.description: An array of user identifiers who are owners of the site.

Members.description: An array of user identifiers who are members of the site.
